displayName: OS Credential Dumping: Security Account Manager

tests.name: Registry dump of SAM, creds, and secrets
tests.description:
Local SAM (SAM & System), cached credentials (System & Security) and LSA secrets (System & Security) can be enumerated
via three registry keys. Then processed locally using https://github.com/Neohapsis/creddump7

Upon successful execution of this test, you will find three files named, sam, system and security in the %temp% directory.

tests.name: Registry parse with pypykatz
tests.description:
Parses registry hives to obtain stored credentials.

Will create a Python virtual environment within the External Payloads folder that can be deleted manually post test execution.

tests.name: esentutl.exe SAM copy
tests.description:
Copy the SAM hive using the esentutl.exe utility
This can also be used to copy other files and hives like SYSTEM, NTUSER.dat etc.

tests.name: PowerDump Hashes and Usernames from Registry
tests.description: Executes a hashdump by reading the hashes from the registry.

tests.name: dump volume shadow copy hives with certutil
tests.description:
Dump hives from volume shadow copies with the certutil utility, exploiting a vulnerability known as "HiveNightmare" or "SeriousSAM".
This can be done with a non-admin user account. [CVE-2021-36934](https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2021-36934)

tests.name: dump volume shadow copy hives with System.IO.File
tests.description: Dump hives from volume shadow copies with System.IO.File. [CVE-2021-36934](https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2021-36934)

tests.name: WinPwn - Loot local Credentials - Dump SAM-File for NTLM Hashes
tests.description: Loot local Credentials - Dump SAM-File for NTLM Hashes technique via function of WinPwn

tests.name: Dumping of SAM, creds, and secrets(Reg Export)
tests.description:
Local SAM (SAM & System), cached credentials (System & Security) and LSA secrets (System & Security) can be enumerated via three registry keys. Used reg export to execute this behavior
Upon successful execution of this test, you will find three files named, sam, system and security in the %temp% directory.
